paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Shevuot 24b](https://www.sefaria.org/Shevuot.24b.23), where he reported a teaching in the name of Rabbi Zeira.[^1]

notes.text: The linked line names Rav Ashi of Avirya as the transmitter and Rabbi Zeira as his source. Hyman writes Avira. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=644&lang=en) cites the same transmission and records a different place-name reading.
